paite: Huai thute Jesu'n agen khit in van lam nga in, "Pa ahun atungta, Tapa in nang ahon pahtawi theihna ding in na Tapa pahtawi in;
heading: Jesu Thumna
english: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

paite: huchi a mi tengteng tung a thunei a na bawl in, akiang a na piak peuhmahte tangtawn hinna apiaktheihna ding in.
english: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

paite: Hiai tangtawn hinna ahi, nang Pathian tak kia leh na sawl Jesu Khrist theih.
english: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

paite: Nang thilhih ding na hon piakte ka hih khinta a, khovel ah ka hon pahtawita hi.
english: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

paite: Pa aw, khovel om ma a na kiang a thupina ka neih in, tu in nangmah kiang ngei ah hon pahtawi in.
english: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

paite: "Nang khovel a kipan a mi, kei na hon piakte kiang ah na min ka hihlangta; amau nang a ahi ua, nang amaute kei na hon piak ahi uh; amau lah na thu azuita uhi.
english: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

paite: Nang kei na hon piak tengteng nang a kipan ahi chih atheita uhi.
english: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

paite: Nang thu na hon piakte akiang uah ka peta a; huaite akem ua, nang a kipan ka hi chih diktak in atheita uh, nang na hon sawl chih leng agingta uhi.
english: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.

paite: "Amaute a ding a ngetsak ka hi. Khovel a dia ngetsak ka hi kei, nang na hon piakte a ding ahi zaw, nang a ahi uhi.
english: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

paite: Thil tengteng kei a peuhmah nang a ahi a, nang a lah kei a ahi a; amau ziak in pahtawi in ka om hi.
english: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

paite: Huan kei zaw khovel ah ka omta kei ding, hiaite bel khovel ah a-om ding uh; kei na kiang ah ka hong paidekta hi. Pa Siangthou aw, nang kei na hon piakte na min in hum in pum khat ahihtheihna ding un, eimah pum khat i hih bang in.
english: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

paite: Akiang ua ka om sung in, nang kei na hon piakte na min in ka hum a; amau ka don a, alak ua khat leng amangthang kei hi, mangthang tapa lou ngal, Laisiangthou atangtun theihna ding in.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

paite: Himahleh tu in na kiang ah ka hong paidekta; khovel ah hiai thute ka gen ahi, ka kipahna amau ua aneih kimna ding un.
english: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

paite: Na thu akiang uah ka peta hi; khovel in amau ahua a, khovel a ahih louh ziak un, kei khovel a ka hih louh mah bang in.
english: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

paite: Nang amaute khovel a kipan na lakkhiak ding ngen ka hi kei a, migilou lak ah na hum ding ka chi ahi zaw hi.
english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

paite: Amau khovel a ahi kei uh, kei khovel a ka hih louh mah bang in.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

paite: Amau thutak in hihsiangthou in, na thu thutak ahi.
english: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

paite: Nang khovel a kei na hon sawl bang in, khovel ah amaute ka sawl hi.
english: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

paite: Amau ziak in ka kihihsiangthou a, amaute leng thutak a asianthouna ding un.
english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

paite: "Hiaite a ding kia a ngetsak ka hi kei, athugen ziak ua kei hon gingta lai dingte a ding in leng ka ngetsak hi; avek ua pum khat ahihna ding un;
english: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

paite: Pa, nang keimah a na om leh kei nangmah a ka om bang in, amau leng eimah a a-omna ding un; nang kei na hon sawl chih khovel in ataksan theihna ding in.
english: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

paite: Huan nang thupina na hon piak ke'n amau ka peta; amau pum khat ahihtheihna ding un, ei pum khat i hih mah bang in.
english: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,

paite: Kei amau ah, nang kei ah, amau pum khat a a-om ua abukim theihna ding un; nang kei na hon sawl chih leh na hon it bang in amaute na it chih khovel in atheihtheihna ding in.
english: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

paite: "Pa, nang kei na hon piakte, ka omna a ka kiang a om ding in ka deih; leilung pian ma a itna a nang na hon piak ka thupina amuhtheihna ding un.
english: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

paite: Pa diktat aw, khovel in nang hon thei kei mahleh, ke'n zaw ka hon thei hi; hiaite'n leng nang kei na hon sawl chih athei uhi.
english: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

paite: Huan akiang uah na min ka theisakta a, ka theisak lai ding, nang kei na hon itna bangbang na itna amau a a-om a, kei leng amau a ka omtheihna ding in,” achi hi.
english: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
